items.description: Evaluates safe stencil binding expressions. The grammar is deliberately tiny: literals, bare identifiers that read the element's props, the built-ins size.w, size.h and repeat.index, arithmetic and comparison operators, ?? and ternary conditionals, and the single permitted function token(key, fallback). Any other call is a parse error. The public evaluation APIs never throw — an unparseable or nonsensical expression yields StencilValue.Null — so a broken stencil pack cannot take the editor down.

members.name: Evaluate
members.description: Parses and evaluates an expression string. Returns StencilValue.Null on any failure.

examples.title: Use StencilEvaluator

items.description: A parsed safe binding expression. Public parsing APIs never throw on malformed input: they return a literal-mode instance with IsMalformed set to true. The only permitted function call is token(key); any other call becomes a parse error and is handled by the same literal fallback. Parse once and hand the instance to StencilEvaluator.Evaluate to avoid re-parsing in hot render paths.

members.name: Parse
members.description: Parses text; on failure returns a literal fallback and never throws.

members.name: TryParse
members.description: Parses text and reports diagnostics without throwing.

examples.title: Parse once, evaluate many times

items.description: Undo/redo history for a single wireframe editor instance. Not a DI service. TmWireframeEditor creates one instance and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue. Each editor on the page gets its own isolated stack.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears both stacks (e.g. after loading a new document).

members.name: Push
members.description: Executes command and pushes it onto the undo stack. Clears the redo stack. Move coalescing: if the previous command is a MoveElementsCommand targeting the same element ids and was pushed within 100 ms, the new command is merged into it (keeps the original "before" positions, updates "after").

members.name: Redo
members.description: Re-applies the most recently undone command. No-op if stack is empty.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Reverses the most recent command. No-op if stack is empty.

members.name: NextRedoName
members.description: Name of the next command that would be redone, or null.

members.name: NextUndoName
members.description: Name of the next command that would be undone, or null.

members.name: Revision
members.description: A counter that grows by one on EVERY change of the history - a push (also a coalesced one, which edits the document without adding a step), an undo, a redo and a clear. The editor feeds it to the canvas' render gate as the "the document changed behind your back" token, so a command path can no longer forget to bump a hand-kept version.

items.description: Produces a clean, interaction-free SVG RenderFragment for a single WireframePage. This is the shared presentation layer reused by the live canvas and by headless server-side rendering (IWireframeSvgRenderer), so the visual stays in one place and previews cannot drift from the editor. It renders only presentation: the page <svg> root plus connector arrow markers (and an optional grid) in <defs>, the page background, visible connector paths and their labels, and each element as a translated inner-<svg> viewport hosting the component.

items.description: The shape a wireframe stencil theme name must have (decision WIREFRAME-STENCIL-THEME): at most MaxLength characters from [A-Za-z0-9._-]. The library treats any other name as the default tokens (no warning, nothing stored), and a host that takes a theme from request input (a query string, an export body) should reject it with the same rule before it reaches a log or a renderer.

members.name: IsValid
members.description: true when name is unset (null / blank) or a well-formed theme name. Surrounding white space is ignored. Well-formed does not mean known: an unknown name is still valid and draws the default tokens.

items.description: Floating context menu for the wireframe editor. Rendered at screen coordinates via position:fixed. Supports Canvas, Element and MultiSelect menu variants.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: Anchored (default) renders the position:fixed menu at the pointer; Sheet renders the shared bottom action sheet of the core overlay panel (the mobile long-press menu: finger-sized rows and a Done button; align, distribute and grouping are tablet+ and not offered).

items.description: SVG-based wireframe canvas. Renders WireframeDocument elements as scalable SVG shapes and handles pan, zoom, drag-move, resize (8-handle), rubber-band multi-select, element drop from toolbox, keyboard nudge, and context menu. Communicates with wireframe-designer.js for pan, zoom, drag, resize and selection; every gesture is a Pointer Event, so a mouse, a finger and a pen all work. One pointer selects, drags (single or multi, groups included), resizes through the 8 handles, rotates, rubber-bands, draws connectors (connector tool) and drags connector waypoints, all on the shared pointer-drag.js helper; a 500 ms touch hold opens the context menu beside the finger; two fingers pinch-zoom and pan (the shared pointer-gesture.js, zoom clamped to 0.15x-5x) and ctrl+wheel / trackpad pinch zooms around the cursor; a double-tap is a double-click (adds a connector waypoint). On a coarse pointer the selection handles are painted 1.5x larger with an invisible hit area of at least 24 screen px, and the svg claims the touch (touch-action: none). The non-drag alternatives are the arrow keys (Shift = one grid cell), the inspector X/Y/W/H fields, the zoom buttons and tap / Enter / Space insertion from the toolbox. A mouse keeps the middle-button pan, Space+drag and the right-click menu. Hosts that listened to mouse events on the canvas svg now get pointer events (see the CHANGELOG migration note); the HTML5 toolbox drag-and-drop is unchanged. All mutations go through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Typically used as a child of TmWireframeEditor rather than directly.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the canvas wrapper div.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

parameters.name: ContentVersion
parameters.description: Opaque token the host bumps whenever the document content may have changed behind the canvas' back. While LightEditing is true a parent re-render with unchanged parameters and token does not repaint the SVG scene, so opening or switching a sheet above the canvas costs it nothing.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document to display and edit. Mutated in-place; bind with @bind-Document.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every mutation so callers can persist the document.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in SVG units (pixels). 0 = disabled.

parameters.name: InitialZoom
parameters.description: How the view is laid out at the first render, when Document is replaced, when the active page or its size changes and when this value changes. Fit (default) fits the page with a 40 px padding but never enlarges it past 100 %; ActualSize shows it at 100 %. A zoom the user chose is never overwritten automatically; OnZoomChangedEvent reports the real scale.

parameters.name: LightEditing
parameters.description: Mobile viewing + light edits (G2). While true the canvas keeps selecting, moving an element with a finger, the long-press menu and pinch / pan, but drops resize / rotate handles, the rubber band (a one-finger drag on the empty canvas pans), the connector tool and waypoint handles, and gates parent re-renders on ContentVersion. TmWireframeEditor sets it below 768 px.

parameters.description: Raised when the user changes the selection. Payload is an array of selected element IDs.

parameters.name: OnZoomChangedEvent
parameters.description: Raised with the new zoom factor (screen pixels per SVG unit, 0.15-5) after the user zooms with the mouse wheel, a trackpad pinch or a two-finger pinch, and once after the first render with the real fitted scale. The editor uses it for its zoom read-out; the toolbar zoom buttons set the zoom through SetZoom and do not raise it.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables all editing interactions (drag, resize, rotate, drop, nudge, long-press menu). Navigation stays: the pan tool, Space+drag, the middle mouse button, two-finger pinch/pan and the wheel.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Render grid lines on the canvas background.

parameters.name: SnapToObjects
parameters.description: When true, dragged elements snap to edges/centers of other elements.

parameters.name: StencilTheme
parameters.description: The stencil theme the elements are drawn with (indigo, indigo-dark, dark, ...). Resolution order: this parameter, the active page TargetTheme, the document TargetTheme, the default tokens; an unknown name draws the default tokens and logs one warning. The page itself stays white paper.

items.description: Top-level wireframe editor component. Renders through the core TmEditorShell: an optional header (host slots HeaderStart / HeaderActions / Title), ONE command row (a core TmToolbar with named groups - tools, history, arrange, group, align, snap, zoom, file -, per-button Priority, Labels=Auto and Overflow=Menu; Export is the primary, never-collapsing action; the format painter, Read-only, rulers and the panel toggles live in its "More" menu), a docked left panel (Components / Pages / Layers tabs, Pages only with PageNavigation=Panel), the canvas with rulers, context menu and minimap, and an inspector (Canvas with device presets, Page and Grid sections on an empty selection; Element with a Name field and Delete element on a selection). Creates and owns a WireframeCommandStack (undo/redo) and exposes it to all child components via CascadingValue. Supports JSON import/export, SVG export, zoom, grid, read-only mode and collapsible panels. Tool mode (Select/Pan) can be switched via toolbar buttons or keyboard shortcuts V/H. Canvas size is edited in the inspector (Canvas section). There is no built-in Save or Open: the host supplies them through the header slots. Presentation: every colour, radius and space reads a core --tm-* token through the --tm-wd-* aliases (no local palette, no dark-mode block), so dark mode and the indigo theme work without extra CSS; toolbar buttons are TmIcon (32px; 44px on a coarse pointer). Responsive behaviour follows the editor's own container width (see LayoutMode): desktop docks the panels, a tablet uses a two-row toolbar and one side sheet at a time, and a phone (container below 768 px, decision G2: viewing + light edits) shows a compact header (title + host slots) with a select / pan / undo / redo / More tool row, a full-width canvas with a floating zoom pill, a TmMobileActionBar (Components, Pages & layers, Export, More; host actions through MobileActions) and non-modal bottom sheets (peek / half / full) for the palette, the Properties inspector (type + Duplicate / Lock / Delete on peek, Name and every property on half) and the Pages | Layers segment. Selecting, moving an element with a finger, undo / redo, tap-insert, layers, device presets, export and the long-press action sheet stay; resize / rotate handles, rubber band, edge drawing, align / distribute, grouping, rulers, minimap and JSON import are tablet and up. The export dialog is a bottom sheet on a phone.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root element.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document being edited. Bind with @bind-Document. When null an empty document is created automatically.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every mutation so callers can persist the document.

parameters.name: ExportHttpClientName
parameters.description: Name of the IHttpClientFactory client the PNG / PDF export posts to (api/wireframe/export/png|pdf, resolved against that client base address). Empty uses the injected HttpClient, whose base is the host origin. A host whose page origin does not serve the export endpoints (a WebAssembly app next to a separate API) names the client that points at the API, like TmDiagramEditor.ExportHttpClientName. Without a registered factory, or when the named client has no base address, the injected HttpClient is used.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Initial / host-driven snap-to-grid cell size in pixels; 0 disables snapping. Never assigned by the component - the inspector's Grid section changes an internal value and reports it through GridSizeChanged (@bind-GridSize).

parameters.name: GridSizeChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new cell size when the user edits the grid size in the inspector (use @bind-GridSize).

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host content at the end of the header, after the title (G9 slot) - e.g. an Open... or Save button.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content at the start of the header, before the title (G9 slot). The editor has no built-in Save or Open.

parameters.name: InitialZoom
parameters.description: How the canvas lays out its view at the first render, when the document is replaced and when the active page changes (decision WIREFRAME-INITIAL-ZOOM). Fit (default) fits the page with a 40 px padding but never enlarges it past 100 % - a page that fits stays at exactly 100 % and is centred; ActualSize shows it at 100 % (the page starts at its top-left corner when it is larger than the canvas). A zoom the user chose (buttons, pinch, Ctrl+wheel) is never overwritten automatically, not even by a container resize, and the toolbar zoom read-out always shows the real scale.

parameters.name: LayoutBreakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance layout thresholds for the editor container. null uses the editor default: mobile below 768 (TmBreakpoints.Md), desktop from 1200, tablet in between.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor resolves its layout: Auto (default) measures the editor's own container (not the viewport) against LayoutBreakpoints and sets data-editor-layout on the root; a forced mode pins the presentation (tests, host layouts). Desktop (container >= 1200) docks the left panel and the inspector in the shell, with one toolbar and the minimap card. Tablet (768-1199) renders a two-row toolbar split by group (editing commands, then panel toggles / zoom / Export / Import), the left panel (Components / Pages / Layers) as an overlay drawer and the inspector as a non-modal side sheet with a close button - at most ONE sheet open, selecting an element opens the inspector, inserting a component closes the drawer, Escape closes the sheet and returns the focus to the canvas -, no minimap, a single-column toolbox and 44px targets on a coarse pointer. Mobile (< 768) uses the shell sheet presentation.

parameters.name: MobileActions
parameters.description: Host actions of the mobile action bar (editor container below 768 px, decision G2: viewing + light edits). The built-in tiles - Components, Pages & layers, Export - come first; a host action pinned ActionOverflow.Never (for example "Save") keeps a tile of its own, the others join the "More" menu by their rank. There is no built-in Save or Open: hosts supply them here and in HeaderStart / HeaderActions. Ignored on a tablet or desktop layout.

parameters.name: PageNavigation
parameters.description: Where the pages are presented. Tabs (default) keeps the horizontal page tabs above the canvas (Components and Layers tabs in the left panel); Panel adds a Pages tab (TmWireframePagesPanel) to the left panel and drops the horizontal tabs.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Host-pinned read-only mode: prevents all editing interactions (drag, resize, drop, prop changes, toolbox insertion). Never assigned by the component - the built-in Read-only/Edit toggle drives an internal user state (IsReadOnly = ReadOnly || user toggle) and reports it through ReadOnlyChanged. While ReadOnly=true is pinned and ReadOnlyChanged is not bound the toggle is not rendered, so the editor cannot be unlocked from the UI; use @bind-ReadOnly to follow and own the state.

parameters.name: ReadOnlyChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new effective read-only state when the user flips the Read-only/Edit toggle. Binding it (@bind-ReadOnly) keeps the toggle available while the host value is true.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Initial / host-driven visibility of the grid lines. Never assigned by the component - the inspector's Grid section flips an internal state and reports it through ShowGridChanged (@bind-ShowGrid).

parameters.name: ShowGridChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new value when the user toggles the grid in the inspector (use @bind-ShowGrid).

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Show the shell header row. false (default) keeps the pre-shell look: the title sits at the start of the toolbar row and no header renders - unless a host supplies HeaderStart, HeaderActions or Title, which opens the header on its own.

parameters.name: ShowMinimap
parameters.description: Show the minimap overlay in the bottom-right corner of the canvas.

parameters.name: ShowPageTabs
parameters.description: Show the page navigation (the horizontal page tabs, or the Pages tab of the left panel with PageNavigation=Panel), even when there is only one page.

parameters.name: ShowPropertiesPanel
parameters.description: Show the right-hand inspector. false also hides the Layers tab of the left panel (the two lived together in the right column before the shell restructure). Collapsing the inspector is shell state (the strip toggle or the Properties panel entry in the More menu).

parameters.name: ShowRulers
parameters.description: Initial / host-driven visibility of the rulers around the canvas. Never assigned by the component - the toolbar toggle flips an internal state and reports it through ShowRulersChanged; a later change of the parameter value is adopted again.

parameters.name: ShowRulersChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new value when the user toggles the rulers button (@bind-ShowRulers).

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Show the command row (the core TmToolbar: tools, history, arrange, grouping, alignment, snapping, zoom, export/import) and, unless a header is shown, the document title.

parameters.name: ShowToolbox
parameters.description: Show the component toolbox: the Components tab of the left panel. When no tab is left (no toolbox, no Layers, no Pages) the left panel is not rendered. Collapsing the panel is shell state (the strip toggle or the Components panel entry in the More menu).

parameters.name: StencilTheme
parameters.description: The stencil theme the canvas, the toolbox previews and the exports are drawn with: indigo, indigo-dark or dark for the built-in pack (decision WIREFRAME-STENCIL-THEME). Resolution order: this parameter, the active page TargetTheme, the document TargetTheme, then the default tokens. null, blank, light and default are the default tokens; an unknown name draws the default tokens and logs one warning. The page stays white paper - only the stencils are recoloured, in the browser SVG export and in the server PNG / PDF export alike.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Host content that replaces the built-in editable document title (G9 slot). Opens the header like HeaderStart.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-accent
cssVariables.description: Accent (selection, active button, handles). Alias of --tm-color-primary; follows the default blue, the opt-in indigo theme (data-tm-theme="indigo") and dark mode.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-bg-surface
cssVariables.description: Toolbar, panel and dialog surface. Alias of --tm-bg-surface.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-border
cssVariables.description: Hairlines and control borders. Alias of --tm-border-color.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-canvas-surface
cssVariables.description: Workspace behind the page. Alias of --tm-bg-workspace (indigo off-white / dark slate).

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-canvas-bg
cssVariables.description: The wireframe PAGE. Alias of the theme-invariant --tm-paper: wireframe components are drawn light-on-paper, so the page stays paper in dark mode and the SVG/PNG/PDF export matches the screen.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-grid-minor
cssVariables.description: Minor grid step (drawn at 55% opacity). Alias of --tm-paper-border.

cssVariables.name: --tm-wd-sheet-w
cssVariables.description: Width of the tablet side sheets (the left drawer and the inspector): 20rem, capped at 60% of the canvas region. Replaces the former fixed --tm-wd-toolbox-w / --tm-wd-props-w.

items.description: Modal dialog for exporting a wireframe. Lets the user choose a file name, output format (PNG or PDF), image scale (1x-3x, PNG only), and whether to include the background, then raises OnExport with the assembled export options. The footer pairs a Secondary (outline) Cancel with the Primary Export button.

parameters.name: DefaultFileName
parameters.description: File name proposed (and restored) every time the dialog opens.

parameters.name: InitialFormat
parameters.description: Format preselected every time the dialog opens: "png" (default) or "pdf" (case-insensitive). Any other value falls back to PNG.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the dialog presents on a narrow viewport. Auto follows the core viewport scope: a bottom sheet on a phone, the centred dialog otherwise; a forced value pins one presentation. The footer is always inline (Cancel and Export side by side, sticky in the sheet).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the user cancels, presses Escape or clicks the overlay. The host should set Show to false.

parameters.name: OnExport
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen file name, format and options when the user confirms the export.

parameters.name: Show
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is visible. Every closed-to-open transition resets the form (file name, format, scale, background).

items.description: Layers panel of the wireframe editor: active layer (radiogroup), visibility and lock toggles (aria-pressed), inline rename, per-row menu (rename, move up/down, delete), drag-and-drop reorder with a drop indicator, and a Move to layer selector. Every operation has a non-drag alternative: the row menu, F2 (rename) and Alt+Up/Down (reorder), all through undoable commands.

parameters.name: ActiveLayerId
parameters.description: Id of the active layer (the one new elements are added to). When null/empty the panel shows the page's default layer as active and reports it once through ActiveLayerIdChanged after the first render.

parameters.name: ActiveLayerIdChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new active layer id when the user picks, adds or deletes a layer, and once for the default layer after render.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the panel root.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose active page's layers are listed. Mutated through undoable commands.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the (mutated) document after every layer change.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables every mutating control (add, delete, rename, visibility, lock, reorder, move to layer).

parameters.name: SelectedElementIds
parameters.description: Ids of the currently selected elements; enables the "Move to layer" selector when non-empty.

parameters.name: ShowCollapseToggle
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own collapse tab. Defaults to true (standalone use). Hosts that own the collapse or the surrounding panel pass false: the panel then renders without the tab, is never collapsed and fills the width of its host.

items.description: SVG minimap overlay for the wireframe canvas. Renders a scaled-down thumbnail of the full document with a viewport indicator rectangle. Clicking or dragging on the minimap pans the main canvas. Selected elements are highlighted. Typically rendered as an overlay inside TmWireframeDesignerCanvas via TmWireframeEditor.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the minimap wrapper.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose elements are rendered in the minimap.

parameters.name: NavigateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks/drags on the minimap. Parent should pan the canvas to the requested centre point.

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: Currently selected element IDs – highlighted in the minimap.

parameters.name: Viewport
parameters.description: Current visible viewport region in document coordinates. Updated by the canvas on pan/zoom.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the minimap in pixels.

relatedTypes.name: MinimapViewport
relatedTypes.description: Current viewport region: X, Y, Width, Height in document coordinates.

relatedTypes.name: MinimapNavigateArgs
relatedTypes.description: Navigate-to request: CentreX, CentreY in document coordinates.

examples.title: Minimap bound to canvas viewport
examples.code:
<TmWireframeMinimap Document="_document"
                    SelectedIds="_selectedIds"
                    Viewport="_viewport"
                    Width="180"
                    NavigateRequested="OnMinimapNavigate" />

@code {
    private MinimapViewport? _viewport;

    private async Task OnMinimapNavigate(MinimapNavigateArgs args)
    {
        if (_canvas is not null)
            await _canvas.ScrollTo(args.CentreX, args.CentreY);
    }
}

items.description: Vertical numbered list of a wireframe document's pages: the Pages tab of the TmWireframeEditor left panel (PageNavigation=Panel), also usable standalone. Click switches the active page; each row has a "..." menu (Rename, Duplicate, Move up, Move down, Delete) and an Add page button sits below the list. Every operation has a non-drag alternative (WCAG 2.5.7): the row menu, F2 to rename, Alt+Up / Alt+Down to reorder; HTML5 drag-and-drop is a pointer-only extra. The panel MUTATES Document (page operations are not undoable, like the page tabs) and reports through ActivePageChanged / DocumentChanged. The Delete key never deletes a page; the last page cannot be deleted. ReadOnly removes add, menu, drag, rename and the shortcuts; selecting a page still works.

parameters.name: ActivePageChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the id of the page that became active after a switch, add, duplicate or delete (not for plain reorder or rename), before DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the panel root.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose pages are listed. Mutated in place: pages are added, renamed, reordered, duplicated and deleted, and ActivePageId is set when the user switches page.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the (mutated) document after every change: switch, add, rename, duplicate, delete, reorder.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true the list is view-only: no add button, no row menu, no drag-and-drop and no rename or reorder shortcuts. Selecting a page still works.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own "Pages" heading. Defaults to true for standalone use; a host whose tab or section already says "Pages" (the left panel of the editor) passes false so the word is not repeated.

items.description: Properties panel for the wireframe editor. Shows editable fields for the currently selected element(s). Supports single-select (all PropDef fields grouped by category, plus Layout X/Y/W/H and Element/ZIndex sections) and multi-select (intersection of common props, Mixed indicator when values differ). All mutations are routed through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Text and number inputs use per-field debounce (350 ms); dropdowns and checkboxes apply immediately. Changing a size prop with SizePresets defined automatically resizes the element. With an EMPTY selection the panel shows the Canvas (device preset select - Desktop 1440x900, Laptop 1280x800, Tablet 1024x768, iPhone 14 390x844, Android 360x800, Custom - plus width/height and Apply, all through the undoable ResizeCanvasCommand), Page (rename of the active page) and Grid (show grid, grid size) sections. The Element section has a Name field (undoable RenameElementCommand; the name is the element's aria-label and tooltip on the canvas) and a Delete element button.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel wrapper.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document being edited.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every property change.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in pixels (the Grid section input, 0-128; 0 = snapping off). Never assigned by the component.

parameters.name: GridSizeChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new cell size when the user edits the grid size.

parameters.name: OnCanvasResized
parameters.description: Raised AFTER a ResizeCanvasCommand was pushed (device preset or Apply), so the host can update its canvas.

parameters.name: OnCopyStyle
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests copy style from the selected element.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised by the Delete element button. With a delegate the host performs the deletion; without one the panel pushes a RemoveElementsCommand itself and raises DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: OnPasteSize
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests paste size to the selected elements.

parameters.name: OnPasteStyle
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests paste style to the selected elements.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Prevent all editing interactions.

parameters.name: SelectedConnectorIds
parameters.description: Currently selected connector ids.

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: IDs of the currently selected elements. Empty = no selection shown.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Whether the grid is shown (the Grid section toggle). Never assigned by the component - it keeps local state, raises ShowGridChanged and re-adopts the host value when the parameter changes.

parameters.name: ShowGridChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new value when the user toggles Show grid.

examples.title: Properties panel bound to canvas selection

<TmWireframeDesignerCanvas @ref="_canvas"
                           Document="_document"
                           DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                           OnSelectionChanged="ids => _selectedIds = ids" />

<TmWireframePropertiesPanel Document="_document"
                             DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                             SelectedIds="_selectedIds" />

@code {

    private string[] _selectedIds = [];
}

items.description: Draggable component palette for the wireframe editor. Displays all registered WireframeComponentDef entries grouped by category (a 3-column grid of tiles) with a search filter. A tile shows the component's TmIcon (WireframeComponentDef.Icon) and name; the mini stencil SVG preview is the fallback when the icon is missing or not drawable. Items are draggable onto TmWireframeDesignerCanvas via HTML drag-and-drop (data-component-type attribute). Custom components registered via IWireframeComponentProvider appear in a separate 'Custom' tab. Typically used as a child of TmWireframeEditor rather than directly.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the toolbox wrapper.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

parameters.name: OnComponentActivated
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates a component by click, tap or keyboard (Enter/Space), exactly once per gesture - the non-drag alternative to HTML5 drag-and-drop. Payload is the component type string (e.g. 'TmButton'); the editor inserts it centred in the visible canvas area.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Shows the palette inert: items are aria-disabled, muted (tm-wd-toolbox__item--disabled), not draggable and never raise OnComponentActivated. TmWireframeEditor passes its effective read-only state (host ReadOnly or the user Read-only toggle).

parameters.name: SingleColumn
parameters.description: Presents the palette as a single column of named rows (icon + name, a finger-sized target) instead of the 3-column tile grid. TmWireframeEditor sets it for its tablet overlay drawer; adds the tm-wd-toolbox--single-column modifier.

parameters.name: StencilTheme
parameters.description: The stencil theme the mini-stencil previews are drawn with (indigo, indigo-dark, ...), so a recoloured canvas and its palette agree. null or unknown = the default tokens. TmWireframeEditor passes its resolved theme.
